integrity: Proof supplies all-abelian-group argument. Finite-field computations confirm bounded cases only; self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite latin Alexander quandles over splitting fields whose characteristic is prime to group order; no classification in the nonsplitting, modular or nonlatin cases. A prior Fourier-product identity is explicitly credited, and priority relative to general twisted-coordinate algebra results remains uncertain.
title: The square-zero spectrum of finite latin Alexander quandle algebras
